notes.title: Paragon™ Pinball Just release!
notes.notes:
Paragon™ Pinball has just been released for: Steam, iOS, Google Play, Mac and Amazon!

Coming Soon: OUYA

https://youtu.be/j70N6r-teXM
Paragon™ (1979): Was designed by Greg Kmiec and drawn by Paul Faris. This beautifully illustrated table was the first Supersize widebody table made by Bally. This table was one of the first to use inline drop targets, in the Valley of Demons, to score points and multiply the Bonus. The table also features four Flippers on the Playfield to control the ball away from the Beast's Lair, the dangerous outlane gap under the Pop Bumper on the left. This table challenges players with every game, and is a great game to hone flipper control and nudging skills. "Enter the exciting world of Paragon!" 



	    PC (DX9/DX11), Mobile Updates
    General
            
            Added Paragon, the first table of Season 7.        
                
            Added 17 new challenges for seasons 2 - 6.        
                
            Added the Reset Highscores button to the local highscores screen.        
                
            Added high resolution backglasses for many tables.        
                
            EM tables now display their score on the backglass.        
                
            Fixed the black and white ball texture.        
                
            Fixed the camera getting stuck on the plunger camera during            multiball.        
                
            Fixed several issues that made navigating the UI difficult when            using the DPad or the arrow keys.        
                
            Fixed an issue that would cause the game to repeatedly click            buttons.        
                
            Fixed the logo on the main menu in DX11.        
                
            Fixed the Play Random button loading tables that don't exist.        
                
            Fixed the game lagging when the Goal Completed notification            appeared.        
                
            Fixed the coin door menu buttons on Android.        
                
            Fixed some tables not restarting after exiting the coin door on            Android.        
                
            Replaced several generic sounds used on older tables.        
                
            Removed all skill shot cameras to prevent users from being stuck in            them at the start of the game.        
                
You can now use            username+XX@domain.com            email address aliases when creating an account.        
    
    Al's Garage Band
            
            Added the mirror to DX11.        
                
            Added ball rendering to the DX9 mirror.        
                
            Fixed plunger camera during Brain Damage multiball.        
                
            Fixed an issue where the table sometimes wouldn't start correctly.        
    
    Bone Busters
            
            Fixed playing Bone Busters causing issues with other Gottlieb            System 80B tables.        
                
            Fixed the skill shot goal not triggering if you hit the left trap            instead of the right trap.        
                
            Fixed the 2x skill shot goal not triggering if you hit the right            trap first.        
                
            Fixed dip switch settings not being restored after disabling            operator mode.        
    
    Cactus Canyon
            
            Cameras have been updated for PC.        
    
    Cactus Jacks
            
            Fixed the Throw Watermelon goal        
                
            Fixed the 3,500,000 million point bonus goal.        
    
    Cirqus Voltaire
            
            Tuning has been updated.        
                            
                Elasticity was updated to reflect current values used on new                tables.            
                            
                The vacuum effect was removed from the ramp and back habitrail.                If the shot is failed, the ball will roll back.            
                            
                The Juggler Locks often failed - This is now fixed.            
                            
                The menagerie ball now reflects a plastic ball being hit, not                rubber.            
                            
                The pitch of the table was increased as the table felt far too                floaty            
                            
                The Magnet effect now snaps the ball into position when locking                the ball at the juggler and high wire locks.            
                            
                You can see the new tuning in action here:                                    https://youtu.be/s2Ihikr1GU8                            
                        
            Collision sounds were updated for rubber, metal and plastic pieces.        
                
            Cameras have been updated.        
                
            Several collision issues have been fixed.        
    
    Creature From the Black Lagoon
            
            Tuning has been updated.        
                            
                Vacuum ramps were removed.            
                            
                Top ramp is much harder to complete and failed shots tend to                fall SDTM or to the left flipper.            
                            
                The right ramps slope was adjusted accordingly.            
                            
                Pop bumpers and slingshots strength was slightly increased.            
                            
                The ball and other plastics can now correctly be seen under all                transparent plastics.            
                            
                Elasticity was updated to reflect current values used on new                tables.            
                            
                Bowl physics was updated so that the ball would naturally roll                and hit the switch 2 times. It is possible to nudge to get the                ball to rotate for more hits. but is challenging as it should                be.            
                            
                The pitch of the table was increased as the table felt far too                floaty.            
                            
                General collision sounds were not properly assigned such as                rubber, metal, wood, and plastic hits.            
                            
                Some minor flipper tuning to adapt to increased pitch of the                table.            
                            
                You can see the new tuning in action here:                                    https://youtu.be/MlmRApSTpcU                            
                        
            Cameras have been updated.        
                
            Several collision issues have been fixed.        
    
    Eight Ball Deluxe
            
            Fixed dip switch settings not being restored after disabling            operator mode.        
    
    Fish Tales
            
            Fixed score detection for scores higher than 10 billion.        
    
    Flight 2000
            
            Fixed dip switch settings not being restored after disabling            operator mode.        
    
    Genie
            
            Tuning has been updated.        
                            
                Elasticity of rubbers was fixed            
                            
                Round targets were kicking the ball back which is incorrect and                was removed.            
                            
                The pitch of the table was adjusted so the table would play                more like an EM.            
                            
                The flipper strength felt to strong for an EM and was lowered.            
                            
                Pop bumpers strength was adjusted.            
                            
                Inlane metal wall elasticity was increased so the ball would                have a more random behavior.            
                            
                You can see the new tuning in action here:                                    https://youtu.be/s-0QS7Le_PY                            
                        
            Cameras have been updated.        
                
            Several collision issues have been fixed.        
    
    Haunted House
            
            Fixed incorrect collisions on the left cellar flipper.        
    
    Lights Camera Action
            
            Fixed the following DX11 lighting issues:        
                            
                Lamp #31, the 2nd Scene Complete light, is dim.            
                            
                The lower two yellow arrows, #56 and #57, on the drop target                bank, are dimmed.            
                            
                Many of the card lights are dimmed. Lights #71, 72, 73, 74, 80,                81, 82, 83, 84, 90, 91, 92 ,93, 94, A0, A1, A2, A3, A4, B1, B2,                B3, and B4.            
                            
                Light #75, the Kickback lane light, is tied in with the Special                light at the spinner.            
                            
                Light #76 is at the first K light on the backglass. Not sure                where it's supposed to be.            
                            
                Light #77, the Special light at the spinner, is dimmed.            
                            
                Light #83, the fourth K, is tied in with Collect Countdown and                Jackpot at the center drops.            
                            
                Light #84, the fifth K, is tied in with Enter Stunt Scene and                50K at the center drops.            
                            
                Light #85, the Collect Countdown light, coincides with the 100k                light on the right visible target.            
                            
                Light #86, the Enter Stunt Scene light, is tied with the first                Q.            
                            
                Light #87, the 100k light at the target, is dim.            
                            
                Light #93, the fourth Q, ties in with the 100K light at the                loop.            
                            
                Light #94, the fifth Q, ties in with the Million light at the                loop.            
                            
                Light #95, the 100k Loop, ties in with the Special at the loop.            
                            
                Light #96, the Million light, coincides with the first J.            
                            
                Light B5, the Jackpot light, is dimmed.            
                            
                Light B6, the 50K light at the drop targets, is dimmed.            
            
    Medieval Madness
            
            Fixed the light on the left ramp never turning off.        
                
            Added video mode camera.        
                
            Collision sounds were updated for rubber, metal and plastic pieces.        
                
            Tuning has been updated.        
                            
                Vacuum ramps were removed            
                            
                The pitch of the table was increased            
                            
                Elasticity of metal, rubber and plastic collisions were                adjusted            
            
    No Fear
            
            Fixed missing mechanical sounds in DX11.        
    
    Swords of Fury
            
            Fixed instructions incorrectly stating that the lionman bonus is            held.        
    
    Terminator 2
            
            Tuning has been updated.        
                            
                Table slope was increased            
                            
                Sticky targets were removed            
                            
                Trap kickouts are more random            
                            
                Plunger skillshot was adjusted to hit the 2nd target from the                top            
                            
                Vacuum ramps were addressed            
                            
                Rubber elasticity was increased            
                        
            Cameras have been updated.        
                
            Collision under the Terminator head was fixed.        
                
            Collision sounds were updated for rubber, metal and plastic pieces.        
                
            Added video mode camera.        
    
    Theatre of Magic
            
            Fixed the mirror in DX11.        
                
            Tuning has been updated        
                            
                Table slope was increased            
                            
                Vacuum ramps were addressed            
                            
                Collision Elasticity was increased.            
                        
            Collision sounds were updated for rubber, metal and plastic pieces.        
                
            The trapdoor collision was fixed.        
                
            Collision sounds were updated for rubber, metal and plastic pieces.        
    
    Twilight Zone
            
            Tuning has been updated.        
                            
                Tuning update is still in progress.            
                        
            Cameras have been updated.        
                
            Several collision issues have been fixed.        
    
    TX Sector
            
            Fixed dip switch settings not being restored after disabling            operator mode.        
    
    Xenon
            
            Fixed dip switch settings not being restored after disabling            operator mode.
